purpose: On licensed fresh HOLDOUT text, causally test whether the natural L11H3 subject-self score distinguishes subject number, whether its downstream effect reverses with the subject effective-value state, and whether same-number lexical score changes are smaller.

licensed_precondition.evaluated_rows: HOLDOUT only; all FIT rows are forbidden to the causal runner

prior_art_audit.finding: On reused OOD text, changing the subject-self score had opposing effects under native versus donor subject values. This motivates a fixed score-by-value interaction prediction but is not fresh confirmation.
Natural QK branches produced a signed number-dependent effect on reused OOD text. The result did not isolate a matched token-8-only score change on fresh text.

The first fresh causal instrument was invalid because opposite-versus-recipient score also changed a foreign prefix and failed one registered liveness cell. Its contrast remains diagnostic only and is not recomputed here.

site.score: The exact natural subject-self source score p_8 captured by replay_attention_with_source_factors.
site.effective_value: The exact post-OV subject-source vector u_8, so the installed source term is p_8 u_8.
site.background: Every non-subject source term remains the recipient's exact native term.

estimands.number_score_under_same_value: Change in the fixed are-minus-is margin from opposite_score_same_value minus same_score_same_value.
estimands.number_score_under_opposite_value: Change in the fixed are-minus-is margin from opposite_score_opposite_value minus same_score_opposite_value.

metrics.fixed_are_minus_is_margin: The ' are' logit minus the ' is' logit, independent of which answer is donor-correct; used only for signed number discrimination and lexical selectivity.
metrics.recipient_CE_improvement: native recipient-answer full-vocabulary CE minus patched recipient-answer CE; positive is better
metrics.donor_CE_improvement: native opposite-answer full-vocabulary CE minus patched opposite-answer CE; positive is better
metrics.rule: CE improvement is always answer-directed. It is never multiplied by a singular/plural expected sign.

fixed_predictions.instrument: Exact replay/source algebra/no-op installation must pass, and complete opposite-head replacement must improve donor margin and donor CE in every direction-by-template cell.
fixed_predictions.number_discrimination: Using only fixed are-minus-is margin, at both value states the opposite-minus-same score effect is live and its sign reverses when the value state changes. Under opposite value it is positive for singular-to-plural and negative for plural-to-singular; under same value those signs reverse.
fixed_predictions.lexical_selectivity: Using fixed are-minus-is margin at both value states and in every cell, the absolute mean same-number lexical score effect is at most one quarter of the matched opposite-number score effect.
fixed_predictions.bidirectional_task_use: Opposite score under opposite value improves donor margin and donor CE in both subject-number directions.
fixed_predictions.directional_asymmetry: The opposing alternative is that opposite score under opposite value helps singular-to-plural but harms plural-to-singular, despite a capable complete-head transplant.

terminal_policy: Fail exactness or complete-head capability -> invalid instrument. Otherwise preserve number-discrimination/selectivity and task-use predictions independently; do not repair rows, thresholds, or directions after outcomes.
closed_claims: syntax generality beyond the two licensed templates
